name: gitmemory
description: Registers gitmemory's hook shim on PreCompact and SessionEnd, so a session is captured at the compaction boundary, and adds a recall skill that has the agent search past sessions with gitmemory recall and quote each line with its address. Neither captures anything: the gitmemory watcher must be installed (uv tool install --python 3.13 git+https://github.com/doronp/gitmemory), configured (gitmemory init claude-code) and running (gitmemory watch).
